mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id=rm.menu_id WHERE rm.role_id=#{roleId} AND m.status='0' AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != ''

SELECT m.menu_id AS menuId,m.parent_id AS parentId,m.menu_name AS menuName,m.path,m.menu_type AS menuType,m.perms FROM sys_menu m JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id=rm.menu_id WHERE rm.role_id=#{roleId} AND m.status='0' ORDER BY m.order_num,m.menu_id
